ios.desc:
Note: This app is only useful for owners of a Philips Hue (Pro) Bridge and lights managed by apple home.

With Home Hue Scene Importer, you can import your existing Philips Hue scenes directly into Apple Home.
Select multiple scenes or entire rooms and transfer them easily. No need to recreate them manually.

Perfect if you want to:
	•	bring your Philips Hue scene setup into Apple Home,
	•	have just switched to Apple Home, or
	•	are migrating to the new Hue Bridge Pro and need to reconnect your scenes.

Simple, fast, and seamless for a perfectly integrated smart home experience.

quotes.text:
When I upgraded to the new Philips Hue Pro Bridge, I noticed that none of my scenes carried over when reconnecting to Apple Home.

To simplify this, I created the Home Hue Scene Importer app.

Hue has since introduced a migration option for individual scenes, but I still find it somewhat inconvenient.

The app is now available here: [https://apps.apple.com/de/app/home-hue-scene-importer/id6753819522](Home Hue Scene Importer) on the App Store
